Head of Finance Job at Sifax Group




        
    

        
        Sifax Group is one of Africa’s fastest growing multinational corporations with diverse interests in Maritime, Aviation, Haulage & Logistics, Oil & Gas and Hospitality.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head of Finance

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Job Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We're seeking an experienced Head of Finance to manage all financial operations and activities of the company.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving financial strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, and contributing to the company's growth.


Responsibilities


	Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with company goals
	Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow
	Provide strategic guidance on risk management and investment opportunities
	Manage capital structure and funding strategies
	Collaborate with executive management to support business growth and operational efficiency
	Drive financial performance, profitability and sustainability Oversee financial reporting and risk management
	Lead the finance team and drive overall financial performance


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field; MBA or equivalent is an advantage
	ICAN, ACCA or equivalent professional certification is required
	Minimum 8 years of experience in senior financial management, preferably within banking or financial services
	Strong knowledge of financial services regulations, IFRS, FRCN
	Experience in strategic portfolio management, cost efficiency modelling and scenario planning
	Strong ability to use digital finance tools and data analytics for decision-making and reporting
	Candidates residing around Ikorodu, Ketu or Mile 12 are preferred


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "title": "Social Media Manager",
  "description": "Ginos Ventures Limited is an Indigenous distributor of medical consumables and devices across Africa, we provide solutions to all problems of procurement, distribution, and supply of all medical consumables.

We currently distribute for over 15 multinational healthcare companies and have a working relationship with about 60% of healthcare institutions in Nigeria with 23 Medical Representatives and 10 mini distributors that cover major regions in the country.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Social Media Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	Are you creative, digitally savvy, and passionate about creating engaging content that builds brands and drives business growth?
	We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Social Media Manager to manage our online presence, create compelling content, and strengthen our brand visibility across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the company&rsquo;s social media accounts and online presence.
	Create engaging content, including graphics, videos, captions, and reels.
	Develop and implement effective social media strategies.
	Plan and maintain a consistent content calendar.
	Monitor engagement, respond to messages, and grow our online community.
	Track performance and prepare social media analytics reports.
	Support digital marketing campaigns and brand promotion.


Requirements


	Proven experience in social media management or digital marketing.
	Excellent writing, communication, and creative skills.
	Proficiency in social media platforms and content creation tools such as Canva.
	Knowledge of video editing and social media analytics.
	Ability to develop creative content and meet deadlines.
	A portfolio of previous work will be an added advantage.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: ginosvacancy@gmail.com using &quot;Social Media Manager&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Social Media Manager Job at Ginos Ventures Limited




        
    

        
        Ginos Ventures Limited is an Indigenous distributor of medical consumables and devices across Africa, we provide solutions to all problems of procurement, distribution, and supply of all medical consumables.

We currently distribute for over 15 multinational healthcare companies and have a working relationship with about 60% of healthcare institutions in Nigeria with 23 Medical Representatives and 10 mini distributors that cover major regions in the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Social Media Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description

title: Job Openings at ACO Nigeria
content:
ACO Nigeria offers a comprehensive range of services, including solar, wind, and battery energy storage, tailored to meet the diverse needs of residential, commercial, and utility clients. With a commitment to driving Nigeria’s energy transition, ACO Nigeria delivers high-quality, reliable, and cost-effective solutions that enhance energy security and support the region’s sustainable development goals.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) HSE Officer

Job Locations: Ijanikin and Ijegun, Lagos 
Employment Type: 3-Month Contract
Resumption: Immediate

Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	ACO Nigeria is seeking a qualified and safety-conscious HSE Officer to support health, safety, and environmental compliance across project sites in Lagos.


Key Responsibilities


	Ensure compliance with company, client, and statutory HSE requirements.
	Conduct daily site safety inspections, toolbox talks, and safety inductions.
	Identify workplace hazards, conduct risk assessments, and implement preventive measures.
	Monitor compliance with PPE requirements and safe working procedures, particularly for work at height.
	Prepare and maintain HSE documentation, inspection reports, and incident records.
	Investigate incidents and near-misses and follow up on corrective actions.
	Promote a strong safety culture and ensure safe working conditions across project sites.


Requirements


	Minimum of 4 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably in construction, engineering, or technical project environments.
	Relevant HSE qualification or certification.
	Valid certification in Working at Height or Scaffolding is required.
	Good knowledge of risk assessment, site inspections, incident reporting, and safety procedures.
	Strong communication, documentation, and reporting skills.
	Must be available to resume immediately.
	Must be willing to work at project locations in Ijanikin and Ijegun, Lagos.


Salary
N250,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 27th October, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) Sales Manager - Solar PV & Bess

Job Location: V.I, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager to drive revenue growth, expand market share, and lead our sales and technical teams across the solar photovoltaic (PV), Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) markets.
	We are looking for a commercially driven leader with strong technical expertise, an established network within Nigeria’s renewable energy sector, and the ability to convert business opportunities into profitable projects.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and business growth.
	Identify new business opportunities across commercial and industrial (C&I), government, Rural Electrification Agency (REA), distribution companies (DisCos), developers, and major EPC markets.
	Build and maintain strategic relationships with key clients, partners, developers, and financiers.
	Lead the end-to-end sales process, from lead generation and business development to negotiation and contract closure.
	Lead and develop the technical team in designing solar hybrid solutions, preparing proposals, costing, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and engineering drawings.
	Oversee technical feasibility studies, site audits, and project handovers to the execution team.
	Recruit, coach, and manage sales and technical teams, setting KPIs and monitoring performance.
	Monitor market trends, forecast sales, prepare reports, and identify opportunities for expansion.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering; an MBA is an added advantage.
	Proven experience in sales management or a similar senior-level position.
	Demonstrated technical experience in solar hybrid C&I projects.
	Strong knowledge of solar PV and BESS technologies.
	Experience developing and implementing sales strategies and managing high-performing teams.
	Proficiency in solar simulation tools such as PVsyst, PVsol, and HelioScope.
	Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, and Microsoft Office.
	Strong business development, negotiation, analytical, leadership, and communication skills.


Application Closing Date: 23rd October, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Business Development Manager


Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	ACO Nigeria is seeking a highly driven Business Development Representative to support the growth of our solar EPC, PV, and Energy Storage portfolio in Nigeria.
	This role plays a strategic part in managing REA (Rural Electrification Agency) accounts, driving solar project sales, developing strong industry partnerships, and ensuring structured reporting and market intelligence.
	The ideal candidate must be experienced in solar business development, tender management, and stakeholder engagement within the Nigerian renewable energy sector.


Key Responsibilities
REA & Government Account Management:


	Identify and map key REA stakeholders, decision-makers, procurement officers, developers, and partners
	Monitor REA tender publications and ensure timely submission of compliant bids
	Track submitted tenders and manage follow-ups through award stage
	Develop structured project investment and feasibility reports
	Provide intelligence on funding streams, grants, and developer financing models
	Build and maintain strong professional relationships across REA departments.


Business Development & Sales:


	Identify and engage major developers, international organizations, and C&I customers
	Generate qualified leads and convert opportunities into solar EPC, PV, and energy storage sales
	Promote ACO Nigeria’s solar solutions and maintain active client engagement
	Build long-term partnerships and strategic alliances
	Drive MW-scale sales growth across EPC and storage projects.


Reporting & Market Intelligence:


	Prepare detailed BD activity reports (daily/weekly)
	Maintain comprehensive customer and developer databases
	Submit lead tracking and opportunity pipeline reports
	Develop tender status and competition analysis reports
	Prepare REA intelligence updates (funding, awarded projects, decision-makers, workflow insights)
	Submit event calendars and networking action plans.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or related discipline
	Proven experience in solar EPC business development or REA-related projects
	Strong understanding of Nigeria’s renewable energy and C&I solar market
	Experience handling government tenders and large-scale solar proposals
	Strong negotiation, networking, and stakeholder management skills
	Excellent analytical and reporting capability.


Application Closing Date: 23rd October, 2026.

Click here to apply online
